name: Alicia
appearance:
Like Beth, Alicia wore a black version of the Claymore uniform. She also shares the same lengthy hair as Beth. The only difference is that her bangs are cut into a straight fringe, with long forelock on the side.
In Alicia's awakened form, she has bladed appendages on her arms, head and neck. Her special black uniform is also not destroyed when she awakens.
Height: 180 cm (5 ft 10.86 in).
